**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mveinot/transmission-control/compare/v2.2.0.413...v2.3.0.425

Notable changes:

* Added an optional torrent Priority column to the main torrent view
* Added a beta update channel, including persisted channel selection
* Added release download progress and assisted update downloads
* Added an option to hide the Dock icon when Planetary is minimized to the tray
